items.text: With a huge thank you to Rebel cells worldwide, we’re proud to celebrate our resistance reaching a stunning milestone of 500,000 Rebels! With each of you taking the fight to the tyrannical rule of the Sun King Azra, we literally couldn’t have done it without you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526104/73e7c39e8005c0f6c588271130619baa24242fcf.jpg"]

To celebrate, we’ve got a date that you can join us to welcome the 1.1 Threads of Fate update to Talamh! You’ll be able to jump into new challenges, corrupted regions, upgraded mounts, and new customisation options as Threads of Fate hits PC and consoles on February 12th!

We know you’ve been waiting a little while, and we can’t wait for you to jump into an upgraded Talamh in February. We know you Rebels are also keen to hear about Cross Play functionality, and while it won’t be landing with 1.1, it is still something we’re working on and we’ll have more news coming soon.
With 500,000 of you Rebels on board, we can’t wait to see what you think of the Threads of Fate update. Your resistance journey in Talamh upgrades soon, including:
New Challenges - the new Mystic Ordeals add a little extra challenge for end-game Rebels. Select from pre-made challenges or design your own and share your challenge with the world.
An Evolving World - with corrupted biomes bringing stronger enemies and enhanced rewards for Rebels who face the challenge
Upgraded Mounts - bringing new, improved abilities and harder-hitting punishment against the hordes of the Crimson Order
Enhanced Customization - with new options for skins and emotes for all four of our Rebel heroes.
If you missed the news, read more about the 1.1 Threads of Fate update in our previous news.
We’ll see you again soon, Rebel!

releases.displayName: Rebels to Arms! Our next hot-fix is ready for the resistance.

items.text: Greetings Rebels new and old!

Firstly, thank you all for being here. Our resistance against the Sun King Azra would not be the same without you. Your feedback and support has been inspiring for our Rebel Leaders (the Guard Crushers), and we cannot thank you enough.
Our crusade against the Crimson Order continues today, as we deploy a set of fixes fresh from the campfire (some may call them “hot” fixes - you see):
We have fixed a soft-lock where Azra knocking companions off screen would hinder transitions
Fixed a soft-lock where counter-clashing Azra explosions would lead to an infinite clash loop
Fixed an issue where overpressuring would lead to infinite overpressure
We’ve stopped adding chamomile and lavender to the Chicken feed (and so they will now enrage as intended)
Fixed a transition issue in the Mowlai Village to prevent out-of-bounds issues
We’ve fixed the visual issue where save slots would not reach 100% (the issue here was just the display - no content was actually locked)
We’ve also given all companions a pep talk to boost their bravery - meaning they can no longer be dismissed by Morta Mima
We’ve also fixed an exploit centred around Brome’s ultimate and the Chaos Past Echo ritual

That’s all for today, but keep a weather eye on the horizon, Rebels! And, once again, please continue to give us your feedback for bug-fixes and your experience in Talamh in general. Your support for our Rebellion means more than you could know!
May the Rituals be ever in your favour, and the Root Sisters ever at your side!
The Absolum Team @ Guard Crush, Supamonks, and Dotemu
Fixed several stability issues around Lizard King and Sun King boss fights
Still some crash/softlock remaining around Sun King Azra, we're aware and are actively working on fixing them!
Fixed an unusual online issue where a desync could lead to save data being overwritten - as a side effect, desync should also happen less often from now on
For players having lost their progress, you can use the following workaround:

The game generates a once-a-day save backup named .savebackup.bin at the same place the savefiles are, in %LOCALAPPDATA%/Local/WOF Save and Config (Steam), if a player reports losing their progress there's always a chance for them to recoup by renaming this file and overwriting any existing save.bin file with this backup file
Fixed an issue around the Infinity Mirror trinket involving wayyyy too many gnolls
Fixed an issue where fully unlocking the game content showed less than 100% completion in the save slot
Partial fix for the progress reporting as 94% instead of 100%, will be fixed completely in the next hotfix
